cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Not That Subject
cards.instruction: Choose one subject you cannot let the scene reach. Redirect whenever the conversation gets close.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Don't open that rent letter yet. Help me hang our new curtains.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The landlord wants an answer today.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. He'll love how we're looking after the place. Let's get a photo of the curtains.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll send him one and ask whether we're behind.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not with that carpet showing. Let's rearrange the room first. You move the sofa; I'll hold your phone.

mechanism: A performs exacting curtain-installation expertise to prevent reaching the rent-arrears subject, redirecting B attempts to contact the landlord into technical corrections.
confusable: Ordinary helpful redecorating permits a rent answer; here each approach to the letter is diverted into the installation.
comparison: Garage alternative corrects diagnostic language; this household scene uses a real physical alignment task.
seedUse: Rent letter, curtain display and landlord photo come from D14-b; S03 changes redirection into leveling and composition corrections.
